final_rationale: The verdict does not change because no genuinely new admissible evidence was provided. The Actor narrowed the claim and made useful concessions, but that is a reframing of the same record, not new proof. That distinction matters here: `compliant_with_caveats` would be appropriate if the caveat were merely explanatory while the policy predicates were already satisfied. Instead, the missing model-card update and disclosure are themselves unresolved conditions of certification under the policy text. The Actor's narrower position is more accurate than an unconditional compliance claim, but on this record it still describes conditional future compliance rather than demonstrated present compliance. The aggregate readiness pass and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support plausibility, but they do not cure the missing documentation/disclosure predicate.
